title: McKinnon's hard drives seized by Office of Naval Intelligence

tellings.quote: And when I got arrested, all my data was taken to OI, Office of Naval Intelligence. So they still have my hard drives. I've tried to get them back for years and they said, "No, it's still an ongoing investigation. You can't touch it."

plain: When the British computer hacker Gary McKinnon was arrested in 2002, all his data went to the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence service, and he says they still hold his hard drives. McKinnon, who says he found signs of a secret NASA space program, tells it himself in a 2026 episode. He says he has tried for years to get them back and was told: "No, it's still an ongoing investigation. You can't touch it."
